guarantees.claim: Four concurrent assertions (i=0..3) each monitor msg_fifo_wmask[8*i+:8] against property wmask_bytealign_p, reporting a violation if the property fails.
guarantees.cond: On every clock edge when rst_ni is deasserted (as controlled by the property).

assumptions.claim: The logic driving msg_fifo_wmask must ensure each 8-bit lane is byte-aligned (all zeros or all ones) while the assertion is active.
assumptions.cond: Whenever the assertion checks are enabled.
assumptions.risk: If a lane contains a partial write mask (e.g., 8'b0011_0011), the assertion fails, indicating a functional bug or potential data corruption.

uncertain_points.claim: The property wmask_bytealign_p is defined in another chunk; its exact condition (edge, enable, duration) is not visible here, leaving the completeness of the check unclear.
uncertain_points.risk: An incorrectly defined property might miss certain misalignment scenarios, allowing undetected errors to propagate.
